description: One clean price per ticker and day
Ticker, date and adjusted close are never missing
Prices are strictly positive
Daily low is not above the daily high
No prices on Saturdays or Sundays
No prices dated after today
No prices before the analysis start (2010-01-01)
Every price date is an index trading day
No unexplained ~100x price level changes (pence/pound unit errors)
One-day moves above 25% (kept; listed for review)
Zero-volume days with an unchanged close (kept; listed for review)
Every raw row on a trading day is either in the clean layer or logged as excluded
Every USD/EUR-quoted price has an exchange rate from within the previous 5 days
Every documented correction in price_corrections.csv changed at least one row
Rows removed from the clean layer (listed with reasons in clean_price_exclusions)
examples: ADM.L, 2010-02-04, flat-bar bad print: large move with open = high = low = close, reversed next day; BGEO.L, 2010-01-04, before usable history (see price_corrections.csv): Before its February 2012 premium listing the London line traded in a different unit (depositary receipts) and 2011 has only 29 days of data; BGEO.L, 2010-01-05, before usable history (see price_corrections.csv): Before its February 2012 premium listing the London line traded in a different unit (depositary receipts) and 2011 has only 29 days of data; BGEO.L, 2010-01-06, before usable history (see price_corrections.csv): Before its February 2012 premium listing the London line traded in a different unit (depositary receipts) and 2011 has only 29 days of data; BGEO.L, 2010-01-07, before usable history (see price_corrections.csv): Before its February 2012 premium listing the London line traded in a different unit (depositary receipts) and 2011 has only 29 days of data

description: FTSE 100 index history starts in the first week of the window
FTSE 100 index data is no more than 7 days old
Between 98 and 102 constituents
Each ticker and ISIN appears once
Every constituent has a valid ICB sector and industry
Every constituent has price data
Every constituent's latest price is within 7 days of the index's latest date
No stock misses more than 2% of trading days after it starts
Stocks whose price history starts after January 2010 (listed later; reported)
examples: GLEN.L, Glencore, 2011-05-19; BGEO.L, Lion Finance Group, 2012-02-28; CCH.L, Coca-Cola HBC, 2013-04-29; BBOX.L, Tritax Big Box REIT, 2013-12-09; AUTO.L, Autotrader Group, 2015-03-19

description: One decision per date
Decision label (hike/cut/hold) agrees with old and new rate
Each decision's old rate equals the previous decision's new rate
New rate equals the official daily Bank Rate (IUDBEDR) on the decision date
Every change in the daily Bank Rate series falls on an MPC decision date
Bank Rate between 0% and 6% throughout
Every decision maps to a trading day within 3 days (except the latest, if not yet traded)
Bank Rate known on every trading day
